title: RDF4J & Neptune
summary: Preserve ontology semantics and verify graph behavior in the actual serving environment.

sections.label: Proposed role
sections.text: Use deterministic SPARQL for known relations, versioned TTL and graph fixtures for reproducibility, and applicable SHACL constraints for structural validation.

sections.label: Environment fidelity
sections.text: RDF4J/local fixtures can support focused checks; they do not by themselves establish equivalent behavior and performance in Neptune. Record the tested engine/environment.

sections.label: Critical checks
sections.text: Measure query plans and latency, preserve provenance and scope, and verify candidate isolation because Neptune’s default graph unions named graphs.

catalog.applicability: An RDF4J and Neptune environment example. It is not the default database architecture for every workflow.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
